<div class="cvt-project">

<div class="cvt-section">

<div class="cvt-label">MOTIVATION</div>

<h1>Where should Condominios de Viviendas Tuteladas be prioritized?</h1>

<p class="cvt-lead">
The IPT-CVT was developed to identify territorial differences
in the conditions that shape the priority for the construction
of Condominios de Viviendas Tuteladas.
</p>

<p>
The index brings together demographic, social, territorial,
institutional and environmental information into a single
territorial prioritization framework.
</p>

</div>
